64303.meaning1: giving good counsel; discussing good topics
64303.commentary: (SNa) sumantamantino'ti dhammaṃ sajjhāyissāma, dhut'aṅgaṃ samādiyissāma, amataṃ paribhuñjissāma, samaṇadhammaṃ karissāmā'ti evaṃ subhāsitabhāsino.

examples.text: sumantamantino dhīrā, tuṇhībhūtā samañ'carā, devā viruddhā asurehi, puthu maccā ca mātali.
dhanapālo nāma kuñjaro, kaṭukabhedano dunnivārayo, baddho kabaḷaṃ na bhuñjati, sumarati nāgavanassa kuñjaro.

64305.meaning1: really large; seriously massive; truly enormous
64305.meaning2: really large; seriously massive; truly enormous

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, mahā vat'āyaṃ bhūmicālo, sumahā vat'āyaṃ bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.

64306.commentary: (DNa) sumāgadhāyā'ti sumāgadhā nāma pokkharaṇī, yassā tīre nisinno aññataro puriso padumanāḷ'antarehi asurabhavanaṃ pavisantaṃ asurasenaṃ addasa.

examples.text: addasā kho nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ.

64308.commentary: (DNa) tassa ca nagarā ahu antalikkhe sumāpitā'ti tassa rañño ākāse suṭṭhu māpitā ete āṭānāṭ'ādikā nagarā ahesuṃ, nagarāni bhaviṃsū'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa ca nagarā ahu, antalikkhe sumāpitā, āṭānāṭā kusināṭā parakusināṭā, nāṭasuriyā parakusiṭanāṭā.
pasannanetto sumukho, brahā uju patāpavā, majjhe samaṇasaṅghassa, ādicco'va virocasi.

64310.meaning1: well free; good to be free (of)

examples.text: alaṃ, āvuso, mā socittha mā paridevittha sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena

64311.commentary: (ANa) sv'eva divaso katamaṅgalo nāma hoti, ten'assa sadā sumaṅgalan'ti vuccati. pabhātam'pi'ssa sadā suppabhātam'eva, sayanato uṭṭhānam'pi suhuṭṭhitam'eva, khaṇo'pi sukkhaṇo'va, muhutto'pi sumuhutto'va.

examples.text: sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.
tasmā have lokavidū sumedho, lok'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsiṃsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.
okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.
bhikkhu bhikkhu, ayaṃ vammiko rattiṃ dhūmāyati, divā pajjalati. brāhmaṇo evam'āha, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti. abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa laṅgiṃ. laṅgī, bhadante'ti.

64314.meaning2: name of the ascetic who eventually became the Buddha Gotama

examples.text: appamatto pamattesu, suttesu bahujāgaro, abal'assaṃ'va sīgh'asso, hitvā yāti sumedhaso.

64317.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: sumbho subho matulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.

64319.meaning1: who carries a normal clay bowl

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati sedakaṃ nāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.

64322.meaning1: name of a deity; lord of the Yāma deities
64322.meaning2: name of a deity; lord of the Yāma deities

examples.text: atthi kho, bhikkhu, yāmā nāma devā… suyāmo nāma devaputto… tusitā nāma devā… santussito nāma devaputto… nimmānaratī nāma devā… sunimmito nāma devaputto… paranimmitavasavattī nāma devā… vasavattī nāma devaputto amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.

64324.commentary: (ANa) suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisū'ti yasmiṃ divase tīṇi sucaritāni pūritāni, tad'āssa seṭṭhacārīsu dinnadānaṃ suyiṭṭhaṃ nāma hoti. (THa) suyiṭṭhenā'ti antar'antarā kalyāṇamittehi dinnasappāyadhammadānena.

examples.text: sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.
suyuddhena suyiṭṭhena, saṅgāmavijayena ca, brahmacariyānuciṇṇena, ev'āyaṃ sukham'edhatī'ti.

64325.meaning1: (of a sacrifice) properly performed; well sacrificed
64325.commentary: (SNa) iti brāhmaṇo bhagavato kathaṃ suṇanto pasīditvā idāni attano pasādaṃ āvikaronto addhā suyiṭṭhan'ti-ādim'āha. tass'attho, addhā mama y'idaṃ idāni suyiṭṭhañ'ca suhutañ'ca bhavissati, pubbe pana aggimhi jhāpitaṃ niratthakaṃ ahosī'ti.

examples.text: addhā suyiṭṭhaṃ suhutaṃ mama y'idaṃ, yaṃ tādisaṃ vedagum'addasāmi, tumhādisānañ'hi adassanena, añño jano bhuñjati habyasesan'ti.

64326.meaning1: coherent; methodical; well composed; carefully arranged

examples.text: suyuttavādī dvipadānam'uttamo, mahābhisakko naradammasārathi, cittaṃ calaṃ makkaṭasannibhaṃ iti, avītarāgena sudunnivārayaṃ.

64327.meaning1: speaking methodically; teaching in a carefully composed manner; (comm) well spoken speech

examples.text: suyuttavādī dvipadānam'uttamo, mahābhisakko naradammasārathi, cittaṃ calaṃ makkaṭasannibhaṃ iti, avītarāgena sudunnivārayaṃ.

64328.meaning1: good battle; great fight; well-fought war

64330.commentary: (VIN 1.2.13) dissanti c'eva suyyanti cā'ti ye saṃmukhā te passanti, ye tiro'kkhā te suṇanti.

examples.text: bhikkhu pan'eva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca
manussasaddo viya suyyati, jānissāma nan'ti sadd'ānusārena gantvā taṃ purisaṃ disvā, yakkho bhavissatī'ti bhītatasitā sare sannayhiṃsu

64331.commentary: (DNa) mahim'iva suro abhivassan'ti suro vuccati devo, mahāpathaviṃ abhivassanto devo viya.

examples.text: akkodhañ'ca adhiṭṭhahi adāsi, dānañ'ca vatthāni sukhumāni succhavīni, purimatarabhave ṭhito abhivissaji, mahim'iva suro abhivassaṃ.

cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā sudantā suguttā surakkhitā susaṃvutā sukh'ādhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ sudantaṃ suguttaṃ surakkhitaṃ susaṃvutaṃ sukh'ādhivāhaṃ hoti
attānañ'ce piyaṃ jaññā, rakkheyya naṃ surakkhitaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ aññataraṃ yāmaṃ, paṭijaggeyya paṇḍito.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho caṇḍo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacco caṇḍo caṇḍotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacco surato't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī'ti?
sīlavā vattasampanno, appamatto vicakkhaṇo, nivātavutti atthaddho, surato sakhilo mudu.

64335.commentary: (THa) surattan'ti kappiyarajanena suṭṭhu rattaṃ, arahantānaṃ buddh'ādīnaṃ ciṇṇatāya arahaddhajaṃ jigucchissanti kāsāvaṃ. kasmā? odātesu samucchitā gedhaṃ āpannā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vatthaṃ parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ, tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjiṭṭhakāya, surattavaṇṇam'ev'assa parisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.
ajegucchaṃ vimuttehi, surattaṃ arahaddhajaṃ, jigucchissanti kāsāvaṃ, odātesu samucchitā.
tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjiṭṭhakāya, surattavaṇṇam'ev'assa parisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.
gandhañ'ca ghatvā surabhiṃ manoramaṃ, atho'pi ghatvā asuciṃ akantiyaṃ, akantiyasmiṃ paṭighaṃ vinodaye, chand'ānunīto na ca kantiye siyā.
tagarañ'ca palāsena, yo naro upanayhati, pattā'pi surabhi vāyanti, evaṃ dhīr'ūpasevanā.

seyyathā'pi, bho, puriso candanaghaṭikaṃ adhigaccheyya, haricandanassa vā lohitacandanassa vā. so yato yato ghāyetha, yadi mūlato, yadi majjhato, yadi aggato, adhigacchat'eva surabhigandhaṃ asecanakaṃ
mālute upavāyante, sīte surabhigandhike, avijjaṃ dālayissāmi, nisinno nagamuddhani.

64344.meaning2: enemy of gods; i.e. an Asura

examples.text: sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu, aho rasaṃ, aho rasan'ti! tadeta'r'ahi'pi manussā kañci'd'eva surasaṃ labhitvā evam'āhaṃsu, aho rasaṃ, aho rasan'ti! tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anusaranti, na tv'ev'assa atthaṃ ājānanti.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu macchasurasenesu
rājā hoti suduppadhaṃsiyo, manuj'indo manuj'ādhipati mah'ānubhāvo, tidivapuravarasamo bhavati, suravarataro'r'iva indo.

64349.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.1) surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā. (VINa) surā nāma piṭṭhakiṇṇapakkhittā, nāḷiker'ādīnam'pi rasena katā surātv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati, tassā'y'eva kiṇṇapakkhittāya maṇḍe gahite merayotv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchatī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: surāmerayapāne pācittiyaṃ.
na saṅkittīsu na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thus'odakaṃ pivanti.

64350.meaning1: talk about liquor; discussion about spirits
64350.commentary: (ANt) surākathā'ti'pi pāṭhoti āha surākathanti pāḷiyaṃ panā'ti. sā pan'esā kathā evarūpā navasurā pītā ratijananī hotī'ti assādavasena na vaṭṭati, ādīnavavasena pana ummattakasaṃvattanikā'ti-ādinā nayena vaṭṭati.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, rājakathā corakathā mah'āmattakathā senākathā bhayakathā yuddhakathā annakathā pānakathā vatthakathā sayanakathā mālākathā gandhakathā ñātikathā yānakathā gāmakathā nigamakathā nagarakathā janapadakathā itthikathā surākathā visikhākathā kumbhaṭṭhānakathā pubbapetakathā nānattakathā lokakkhāyikā samudd'akkhāyikā itibhav'ābhavakathā iti vā iti, evarūpiṃ kathaṃ na kathessāmī'ti.

64356.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
64356.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ puññāni katvā sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde anantaraṃ vuttassa rādhattherassa kaniṭṭho hutvā nibbatti, surādho'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so jeṭṭhabhātari rādhe pabbajite sayam'pi pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karonto nacirass'eva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne
64356.notes: Theragāthā verses 135-136 (TH2.8, TH128) are attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ kho, surādha, jānato evaṃ passato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'āpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhā samatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttan'ti … aññataro ca pan'āyasmā surādho arahataṃ ahosī'ti.
itthidhutto surādhutto, akkhadhutto ca yo naro, laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vināseti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
mahāmāyā'pi devī pure puṇṇamāya sattamadivasato paṭṭhāya vigatasurāpānaṃ mālāgandhavibhūtisampannaṃ nakkhattakīḷaṃ anubhavamānā sattame divase pāto'va uṭṭhāya
surāpānavaggo chaṭṭho.

64364.meaning1: Section 6 of the monk's offences requiring confession

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa evam'assa, sakkā kho me ayaṃ surāpipāsā pānīyena vā vinetuṃ dadhimaṇḍakena vā vinetuṃ bhaṭṭhaloṇikāya vā vinetuṃ loṇasovīrakena vā vinetuṃ, na tv'ev'āhaṃ taṃ piveyyaṃ, yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa evam'assa, sakkā kho me ayaṃ surāpipāsitā pānīyena vā vinetuṃ dadhimaṇḍakena vā vinetuṃ bhaṭṭhaloṇikāya.

64370.meaning1: alcohol and meat; liquor and flesh

examples.text: tassa sattavatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni honti, yāvajīvaṃ acelako assaṃ, na vatthaṃ paridaheyyaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ brahmacārī assaṃ, na methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyyaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ surāmaṃsen'eva yāpeyyaṃ, na odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjeyyaṃ.

64371.meaning1: distilled and fermented liquors; wine and spirits

examples.text: pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinn'ādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
surāmerayapānañ'ca, yo naro anuyuñjati, idh'eva'm'eso lokasmiṃ, mūlaṃ khaṇati attano.

64372.meaning1: drinking distilled and fermented liquor; drinking alcohol

examples.text: surāmerayapāne pācittiyaṃ.
surāmerayapānañ'ca, yo naro anuyuñjati, idh'eva'm'eso lokasmiṃ, mūlaṃ khaṇati attano.

64373.meaning1: distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and states of intoxication
64373.compound: dvanda (surā ca meraya ca majja ca pamādaṭṭhāna ca)
64373.commentary: (ADha) surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhānā'ti ettha surā'ti piṭṭhasurā, pūvasurā, odanasurā, kiṇṇapakkhittā, sambhārasaṃyuttāti pañca surā. merayan'ti pupph'āsavo, phal'āsavo, guḷ'āsavo, madhv'āsavo, sambhārasaṃyuttoti pañca āsavā. tadubhayam'pi madanīy'aṭṭhena majjaṃ. yāya cetanāya taṃ pivanti, sā pamādakāraṇattā pamādaṭṭhānaṃ, tasmā surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhānā.

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinn'ādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.

64374.meaning1: due to distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and states of intoxication
64374.sanskrit: surā + maireya + madya + pramāda + sthāna + pratyayāt

examples.text: yaṃ, gahapati, surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhāyī surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhāna-paccayā diṭṭhadhammikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati

64375.meaning1: due to distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and states of intoxication
64375.sanskrit: surā + maireya + madya + pramāda + sthāna + hetu

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhāna-hetu hananti vā bandhanti vā pabbājenti vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karonti. api nu tumhehi evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā'ti?

64376.meaning1: using distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and getting intoxicated
64376.compound: dvanda (surā ca meraya ca majja ca pamādaṭṭhāyī ca)

examples.text: yaṃ, gahapati, surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhāyī surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhāna-paccayā diṭṭhadhammikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati,

64377.meaning1: distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and states of intoxication
64377.meaning2: spirits, alcoholic beverages, drugs and states of intoxication
64377.compound: dvanda (surā ca meraya ca majja ca pamādaṭṭhāna ca)

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, pakatiyā sīlavatī bodhisattamātā hoti, viratā pāṇ'ātipātā, viratā adinn'ādānā, viratā kāmesumicchācārā, viratā musāvādā, viratā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhānā. ayam'ettha dhammatā.

64378.meaning1: due to distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and states of intoxication
64378.sanskrit: surā + maireya + madya + pramāda + sthāna + pratyayāt

examples.text: yaṃ, gahapati, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhāyī surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhāna-ppaccayā diṭṭhadhammikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikam'pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.

64379.meaning1: practice of drinking distilled and fermented liquor, taking drugs and getting into states of intoxication
64379.commentary: (DNa) surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhān'ānuyogo'ti ettha surā'ti piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā'ti pañca surā. merayan'ti pupph'āsavo phal'āsavo madhv'āsavo guḷ'āsavo sambhārasaṃyutto'ti pañca āsavā. taṃ sabbam'pi madakaraṇavasena majjaṃ. pamādaṭṭhānan'ti pamādakāraṇaṃ. yāya cetanāya taṃ majjaṃ pivati, tassa etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. anuyogo'ti tassa surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhānassa anuanuyogo punappunaṃ karaṇaṃ.
64379.sanskrit: surā + maireya + madya + pramāda + sthāna + anuyoga

examples.text: cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhān'ānuyoge. sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, kalahappavaḍḍhanī, rogānaṃ āyatanaṃ, akittisañjananī, kopīnanidaṃsanī, paññāya dubbalikaraṇī'tv'eva chaṭṭhaṃ padaṃ bhavati.

64380.meaning1: using distilled and fermented liquor, drugs and getting intoxicated
64380.commentary: (SNa) surā-meraya-majja-ppamāda-ṭṭhāyino'ti surāmerayasaṅkhātaṃ majjaṃ yāya pamādacetanāya pivanti, sā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādo'ti vuccati, tasmiṃ tiṭṭhantī'ti surā-meraya-majja-ppamāda-ṭṭhāyino. ayaṃ tāv'ettha asādhāraṇapadassa attho.

examples.text: dhātuso'va, bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti. pāṇ'ātipātino pāṇ'ātipātīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, adinn'ādāyino adinn'ādāyīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, kāmesumicchācārino kāmesumicchācārīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, musāvādino musāvādīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, surā-meraya-majja-ppamāda-ṭṭhāyino surā-meraya-majja-ppamāda-ṭṭhāyīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.

64381.meaningLit: discourse on distilled and fermented liquor

64384.synonym: ādicca, divākara, pabhaṅkara, bhāṇumant, ravi, verocana, sataraṃsī, harissa

examples.text: yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ, suriyo'va obhāsayam'antalikkhan'ti.

64385.commentary: (JAa) balaṃ cando balaṃ suriyo'ti mahandhakāravidhamane aññaṃ balaṃ nāma n'atthi, candimasūriyā'v'ettha balavanto'ti attho.

examples.text: tathāgataṃ arahantaṃ, sūriyo saraṇaṃ gato, rāhu suriyaṃ pamuñcassu, buddhā lok'ānukampakā.
balaṃ cando balaṃ suriyo, balaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā, balaṃ velā samuddassa, bal'ātibalam'itthiyo.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, candaggāho bhavissati, suriyaggāho bhavissati, nakkhattaggāho bhavissati, candimasūriyānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati, candimasūriyānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati

64392.meaning1: like the sun; equal to the sun
64392.commentary: (SNa) sūriyasamā ābhā'ti sūriy'ābhāya samā aññā ābhā nāma n'atthī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: n'atthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi gosamitaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi suriyasamā ābhā, samuddaparamā sarā'ti.

64393.commentary: (DNa) candass'upanisā devā, candam'āguṃ purakkhatvā'ti candanissitakā devā candaṃ purato katvā āgatā. tathā sūriyanissitakā devā sūriyaṃ purakkhatvā.

examples.text: suriyass'ūpanisā devā, sūriyam'āguṃ purakkhatvā, nakkhattāni purakkhatvā, āguṃ mandavalāhakā.

64394.meaningLit: with the might of the sun

examples.text: cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷorājā jan'esabho, āgā pañcasikho c'eva, timbarū suriyavaccasā.
tattha purimesu catūsu kiccesu idāni suriy'ālokassa atthitāya n'atthi, aparāni tīṇi bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ jānantehi bhikkhūhi katāni pariniṭṭhitāni honti.

64397.meaning1: in reference to SN56.37 Paṭhamasūriyasutta and SN56.38 Dutiyasūriyasutta

examples.text: sīsapā khadiro daṇḍo, celā sattisatena ca, pāṇā suriy'ūpamā dvedhā, indakhīlo ca vādino'ti.
paripuṇṇakāyo suruci, sujāto cārudassano, suvaṇṇavaṇṇo'si bhagavā, susukkadāṭho'si vīriyavā.
